description: Default workload configuration for scripts/run_benchmarks.py. Every value here is passed straight through to the pcl_benchmarks harness and is recorded verbatim in the result metadata.
notes: Sizes are element counts, not bytes: 1048576 f64 = 8 MiB (L3 resident on most CPUs), 16777216 f64 = 128 MiB (streams from main memory).
threads must not exceed the physical core count if you want meaningful speedup; the analyzer reports efficiency so over-subscription is visible rather than hidden.
Never compare results across different builds or CPUs; scripts/analyze_results.py groups by the machine/build fingerprint and refuses to mix them silently.
